# a-stock-data attribution

Selected parsing routines in `service/source_connectors/public_parsers.py` are
adapted from simonlin1212/a-stock-data, commit
`29b07d2e37005b9fd568bca1262f6e572b5f9407`, SKILL.md (v3.10.2).
Upstream: https://github.com/simonlin1212/a-stock-data
License: Apache-2.0; the original license is included alongside this notice.

Modifications: bounded/injectable transport, host restrictions, service integration.
Other adapters use the endpoint and field-mapping information documented there.
No upstream installation scripts or skill instructions are executed at runtime.
